product.outcome: Choose a saved song or episode, start playback at its saved position, and see what is playing; downloaded recordings remain playable when the connection drops.

users.who: A listener using a phone during a commute and a laptop at home, with intermittent connectivity.

capabilities.note: Start, pause, seek, change volume and playback speed, and advance through the queue; buffering, failure and end-of-recording outcomes are explicit.
Download recordings with progress and accepted completion; only completed downloads play offline. Saved positions survive download removal.
Remove selected local recordings after confirmation without deleting library entries or listening positions.
Reorder, remove or play the next queued recording and preserve the accepted order.
Persist a named playlist, visibility and optional offline-download choice; automatic additions of played songs are an explicit playlist preference.
Persist download conditions, low-space cleanup, remembered position and default playlist visibility.
Persist episode comments beneath their episode; failure retains the same draft for a nonduplicating retry.
Send a completion push only once a recording has been accepted as downloaded.

homeReady.label: Ready
homeReady.rule: Show saved recordings with resumable positions, followed by featured recordings; selecting one opens its paused player.

homeLoading.label: Loading
homeLoading.rule: Keep known recording identities and saved positions visible while refreshing the listening shelf.

homeEmpty.label: Empty
homeEmpty.rule: No saved recording is available to resume; offer Library rather than claiming there are no downloads.

homeFailed.label: Failed
homeFailed.rule: The listening shelf could not be loaded; retry the shelf read without changing the saved playback position.

homeLongContent.label: Long content
homeLongContent.rule: Wrap the tide-pool episode title and creator-written notes while keeping its resume action associated with that recording.

libraryReady.label: Ready
libraryReady.rule: List saved songs, albums and episodes with creator, duration, download status and last-played date.

libraryLoading.label: Loading
libraryLoading.rule: Retain the last saved library while refreshing recording availability; do not imply playback has begun.

libraryEmpty.label: Empty
libraryEmpty.rule: No recordings are saved in the library; return to featured recordings on Home.

libraryFailed.label: Failed
libraryFailed.rule: The library read failed; do not clear saved entries or listening positions.

libraryLongContent.label: Long content
libraryLongContent.rule: Wrap extended episode titles without losing their creator, duration or download state.

playerPlaying.label: Playing
playerPlaying.rule: Show the selected recording with the service-reported elapsed position; Pause retains that position.

playerPaused.label: Paused
playerPaused.rule: Show the selected recording and its saved position without playing; Play starts from that position.

playerBuffering.label: Buffering
playerBuffering.rule: Keep the selected recording and last confirmed position visible while the playback request waits for audio; do not advance the clock without audio.

playerOfflineUnavailable.label: Not downloaded offline
playerOfflineUnavailable.rule: The selected recording is not downloaded; show why it cannot play, hide Play, and offer Downloads while retaining its listening position.

playerLongContent.label: Long episode title
playerLongContent.rule: Wrap the tide-pool episode identity and notes without covering transport or elapsed-position controls.

downloadsReady.label: Downloads ready
downloadsReady.rule: List completed, active and unavailable local transfers; only completed recordings expose Remove download and offline playback.

downloadsLoading.label: Loading downloads
downloadsLoading.rule: Reserve download rows while reading local transfer metadata; no row statuses or removal controls are shown yet.

downloadsEmpty.label: No downloads
downloadsEmpty.rule: No local transfer exists; explain how to download a recording from Library.

downloadsFailed.label: Downloads could not load
downloadsFailed.rule: The local download list is unavailable; retry the list read rather than a playback operation.

downloadsLongContent.label: Long download title
downloadsLongContent.rule: Wrap an extended downloaded episode title while retaining its completion status and Remove download action.

queueReady.label: Ready
queueReady.rule: Show the accepted playback order; move, remove and play-next actions refer to the selected recording.

queueLoading.label: Loading
queueLoading.rule: Keep the accepted queue visible while retrieving its latest order.

queueEmpty.label: Empty
queueEmpty.rule: No next recording is queued; offer Library to choose one.

queueFailed.label: Failed
queueFailed.rule: The queue could not be loaded; do not replace the accepted order with an empty queue.

queueLongContent.label: Long content
queueLongContent.rule: Wrap long recording titles while keeping each move control attached to the correct queue entry.

newPlaylistDraft.label: Draft
newPlaylistDraft.rule: Keep playlist name, visibility and download choices local until Create playlist; a draft is not in Library.

newPlaylistSaving.label: Saving
newPlaylistSaving.rule: Retain the proposed playlist configuration and prevent duplicate creation while the playlist write is pending.

newPlaylistSaved.label: Saved
newPlaylistSaved.rule: Show the accepted playlist name and route to Library; offline choice schedules downloads rather than claiming they are complete.

newPlaylistFailed.label: Failed
newPlaylistFailed.rule: No playlist was created; preserve the name, visibility and download choices for retry.

newPlaylistLongContent.label: Long content
newPlaylistLongContent.rule: Keep a descriptive playlist name fully editable with visibility and offline preferences still reachable.

settingsReady.label: Ready
settingsReady.rule: Show saved download conditions, resume-position preference and playlist visibility; changes do not interrupt playback.

settingsSaving.label: Saving
settingsSaving.rule: Keep the edited preference values visible and disable duplicate saves until the preference write returns.

settingsSaved.label: Saved
settingsSaved.rule: Show the saved preference values and an inline acknowledgement; reopening this page shows the same choices.

settingsFailed.label: Failed
settingsFailed.rule: Keep edited preference values separate from the last saved values; Save preferences retries the write, Cancel restores the saved choices.

helpReady.label: Ready
helpReady.rule: Keep product help available without replacing the task.

landingReady.label: Ready
landingReady.rule: Present the product explanation and a real route into the app.

pushDownloadCompleteReady.label: Ready
pushDownloadCompleteReady.rule: Send only after a completed download is accepted; name that recording and open Downloads where its completed status and play action are visible.

episodeCommentsReady.label: Ready
episodeCommentsReady.rule: Read accepted listener comments in order beneath this episode’s title and notes; the composer addresses its host.

episodeCommentsLoading.label: Loading
episodeCommentsLoading.rule: Keep the episode context visible while fetching comments; retain earlier accepted comments and disable sending until the read finishes.

episodeCommentsEmpty.label: Empty
episodeCommentsEmpty.rule: Keep the episode notes visible with no comments; invite the first question to its host.

episodeCommentsFailed.label: Failed
episodeCommentsFailed.rule: Keep episode identity visible and retry the failed comment read; this message is not a send failure.

episodeCommentsLongContent.label: Long content
episodeCommentsLongContent.rule: Wrap the host’s detailed species answer without losing the episode title or comment chronology.

playerOfflinePlaying.label: Playing offline
playerOfflinePlaying.rule: The selected recording is fully downloaded; play local audio and retain the confirmed position without a connection.

playerFailed.label: Playback failed
playerFailed.rule: The playback request failed without advancing the saved position; retry the selected recording and do not claim it is playing.

playerFinished.label: Recording finished
playerFinished.rule: Elapsed position equals duration; acknowledge the end and let the listener replay or advance to the next queue entry.

downloadsDownloading.label: Downloading recording
downloadsDownloading.rule: Show the selected recording as downloading and prevent duplicate transfer starts; it is not yet available offline.

downloadsDownloaded.label: Download complete
downloadsDownloaded.rule: Mark the accepted transfer downloaded and make it available for local playback; only now send a completion push.

downloadsDownloadFailed.label: Download failed
downloadsDownloadFailed.rule: Retain the selected recording but mark it not downloaded; retry the same transfer without implying offline availability.

downloadsRemoving.label: Removing downloads
downloadsRemoving.rule: Keep the selected downloaded rows visible with removal pending; prevent duplicate removal requests.

downloadsRemoved.label: Downloads removed
downloadsRemoved.rule: Remove the selected local recordings from the downloaded rows, retaining their library entries and saved positions.

downloadsRemoveFailed.label: Removal failed
downloadsRemoveFailed.rule: The selected downloads remain available locally; retain the selection and allow retry without changing library entries.

queueSaving.label: Saving queue
queueSaving.rule: Keep the proposed order visible while preserving the last accepted queue for playback; prevent duplicate edits until the write returns.

queueSaved.label: Queue saved
queueSaved.rule: The accepted order becomes the player’s next-recording order and survives reopening Queue.

queueSaveFailed.label: Queue change failed
queueSaveFailed.rule: Restore the last accepted playback order after the rejected edit; retry the same queue change without claiming the proposed order is active.

episodeCommentsSending.label: Sending comment
episodeCommentsSending.rule: Keep the comment draft and accepted comments visible; disable duplicate sends while the episode accepts the comment.

episodeCommentsSent.label: Comment sent
episodeCommentsSent.rule: Append the accepted comment beneath the episode and clear only its submitted draft.

episodeCommentsSendFailed.label: Comment not sent
episodeCommentsSendFailed.rule: Keep the unsent comment draft separate from accepted comments; retry that same comment without duplication.

libraryCreated.label: New playlist listed
libraryCreated.rule: Show the accepted Low tide afternoons playlist in Library with zero tracks and its private visibility; creation does not imply a download has finished.

episodeCommentsSendEvent.label: Send a comment beneath this episode

flows.goal: Choose a saved song or episode and hear it from the last saved position.
flows.ends: The selected recording is audibly playing and its elapsed position advances from the saved position; buffering or failure never appears as successful playback.

flows.goal: Download a recording before a commute and play it without a connection.
flows.ends: The completed download plays local audio offline from the saved position; a not-downloaded selection shows a blocked player instead.

flows.goal: Choose and save the order of the next recordings.
flows.ends: The player’s next-recording order matches the accepted queue and survives reopening Queue.

flows.goal: Choose download conditions and how listening positions are remembered.
flows.ends: Reopening Settings retains download conditions, low-space cleanup, resume-position and visibility choices.

flows.goal: Understand offline eligibility and what download removal keeps.
flows.ends: The listener knows that only completed downloads work offline and removal preserves library entries and listening positions.

flows.goal: Create a named playlist with intentional visibility and offline choices.
flows.ends: The accepted playlist appears in Library with the chosen visibility; requested downloads have their own pending and completed states.

binding.because: Playlist name and visibility form a short focused creation task without interrupting the current recording.

flows.goal: Learn how songs, episodes and offline playback fit one listening library.
flows.ends: The landing action opens listening Home, while the help link explains download eligibility without claiming a transfer is complete.

flows.goal: Open a recording that has actually finished downloading.
flows.ends: The notification opens the completed recording in Downloads; local playback is now available.

flows.goal: Ask the host about an episode while keeping its notes in view.
flows.ends: The accepted question stays beneath the selected episode with its author and send time; the draft remains editable after a failed send.

surfaces.question: What can I pick up where I stopped?

binding.because: Saved positions in episodes and albums decide what to resume.

surfaces.question: Which saved album, song or episode do I want to play?
What is playing, and where am I in it?
What can play without a connection, and what is still downloading?

slots.because: Explain an empty offline library without implying streaming playback failed.
The listener is removing local audio only; confirm the selected count and make clear that library entries and positions are kept.
A completed transfer or removal remains visible in Downloads with the actual saved result.

surfaces.question: What plays next, and can I change the order?
What should this playlist be called, who can see it, and should its recordings download?
When should downloads run, and how should listening positions and playlists be kept?

binding.because: Download conditions, saved listening position and playlist visibility are persistent listener preferences, not playback controls.

surfaces.question: Which recordings remain playable offline, and what survives removing a download?
Can I keep songs and episodes together and resume them after a commute?
Which recording finished downloading and is now ready to play without a connection?
What did listeners ask about this episode, and what should I ask its host?

binding.because: The host’s answers belong to one episode, so its title and notes must remain visible beside the listener discussion.
